newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lankan rupee ends lower on import covering.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lankan rupee ends lower on import covering.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed sharply lower against the dollar on import covering by two state banks, dealer said.
The rupee ended at 55.82 to the dollar after opening at its previous close of 55.74. Dealers said the rupee's weakness had little to do with the U.S. missile attack on Iraq.
The Central Bank pushed up the dollar by 4.25 local cents, fixing buying and selling at 55.4672 and 56.5878.
"The dollar hit a high of 55.86 on import covering before easing back," said a Citibank dealer.
The Citibank dealers said the dollar should open stronger on Wednesday in view of overseas gains and more import covering expected.
Overnight call money, which was well supplied, closed at 14.25 percent after opening at 14.5 percent, despite big borrowings in the market, dealers said.
